g.text: The thermal answer belongs to the BEOL integration, not to the memory device

text.tspan: Verified 1D transient solver (analytic x2; MAPDL 1D 0.02%; MAPDL 3D 1.3%). Ceiling is set by a temperature budget, dT = R x 20 W,
so that geometry changes move R and the peak fraction independently rather than being hidden inside a fixed watt budget.

text.style: fill: #1baf7a; font: 7.6px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: E/bit is off the left scale: 0.019-0.374 pJ/bit spans 24.8-490 TB/s, so it remains the one measurement worth asking for.

text.tspan: Substrate thinning is the odd one out: it lowers R but removes the thermal mass that does the duty-cycle averaging, so the two nearly
cancel and only 1.04x survives. A steady-state study would have credited it with the full R improvement.
